svg.title: Gibbs and PrO posteriors in linear regression
svg.desc: Three columns show convex recovery, non-trivial misspecification and trivial misspecification. The Gibbs posterior is red and the PrO posterior is blue. Black crosses mark the coefficient values used to generate the observations.
svg.metadata: Yann McLatchie, Badr-Eddine Chérief-Abdellatif, David T. Frazier and Jeremias Knoblauch, Predictively Oriented Posteriors, Figure 2, https://arxiv.org/html/2510.01915v3#S2.F2. CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Adapted as vector paths, with background colour #F0F1EB.
